title: igs / Overview
description: Facebook scraper: traffic and blocks, AIMD, breakers, registry and parsers, pipeline, coverage, budget, media.

panels.title: Failing registry queries
panels.description: Queries whose active doc_id fails on the canary pages with nothing to promote.

panels.title: Breakers (2 = open)
panels.description: Proxy exit buckets and (query, doc_id) pairs that are not closed.

panels.title: Registry query health
panels.description: 1 = the active doc_id parsed on a canary page; 0 = failing with nothing to promote.

panels.title: Optional fields missing per response
panels.description: The drift baseline: each field now and a week ago.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (query, field) (rate(igs_parse_missing_field_total[1h])) / on (query) group_left () clamp_min(sum by (query) (rate(igs_parse_total[1h])), 1e-9))
topk(10, sum by (query, field) (rate(igs_parse_missing_field_total[1h] offset 7d)) / on (query) group_left () clamp_min(sum by (query) (rate(igs_parse_total[1h] offset 7d)), 1e-9))

panels.title: Shadow parser outcomes
panels.description: A candidate parser's results on sampled responses: same, differs, drift.

panels.title: Consumer lag
panels.description: Records behind per consumer group (leader scheduler).

panels.title: Comment completeness
panels.description: Collected / reported comments per post at job completion, over the last hour.

panels.title: Comment edits and deletions
panels.description: Stored comments edited, marked deleted, or seen again after a deletion, per hour.

panels.title: Deletion checks
panels.description: Full reads of known posts compared with the store, per hour. skipped_partial: the read did not account for Facebook's comment count, so nothing was marked.

panels.title: Media deleted
panels.description: Per hour; ttl_expired should stay at 0.
